attchmntText: Atam Valves Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Financial Results for Q2 and H1 FY27, Standalone Results".
voiceSummary: Atam Valves Limited submitted its press release on un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The company reported revenue from operations of 1,635.41 Lakhs for Q2 FY27, showing 43.36 percent year-on-year growth and 33.10 percent quarter-on-quarter growth. EBITDA for the quarter was 128.18 Lakhs, up 19.03 percent sequentially. Profit before tax stood at 92.42 Lakhs, and profit after tax was 67.66 Lakhs. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations reached 2,864.10 Lakhs, a 20.45 percent increase year-on-year. Half-year EBITDA was 235.86 Lakhs with an 8.24 percent margin. Profit before tax for the period was 177.31 Lakhs, and profit after tax was 131.17 Lakhs. Basic earnings per share for the half year was 1.14. The announcement was signed by Managing Director Amit Jain.

attchmntText: Atam Valves Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Atam Valves Limited filed a statement pursuant to Regulation 32 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015 for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company confirms it did not raise any funds through public issue, rights issue, preferential issue, or Qualified Institutions Placement during the period from 1st July 2026 to 30th September 2026. Consequently, the mode of fund raising, date of raising funds, amount raised, and monitoring agency are marked as not applicable. There is no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds. The statement was signed by Compliance Officer Natisha Choudhary on 14th November 2026.

attchmntText: Atam Valves Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Atam Valves Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 1635.41 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 2864.10 lakhs for the half year. Profit for the period stood at Rs. 67.66 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 131.17 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.59 basic for the quarter and Rs. 1.87 basic for the half year. The board also appointed M/s Sohan & Associates, Chartered Accountants, as internal auditor for the financial year 2026-27. The meeting was held on November 14, 2026.
